title: Resolution to set 2027 property tax class shares
summary: This resolution certifies the final adjusted proportions of the property tax levy paid by each of the city's four property classes for fiscal 2027, as required by state law after the release of the final assessment roll. It updates an earlier June 30, 2026 certification to reflect a new state law allowing the Council to adjust the increase limit for each class's share. Under the new figures, shares rise slightly for classes 3 and 4 and fall for classes 1 and 2 compared to fiscal 2026.
